correctness.rationale: Conditional outdegree is Bin(n-1,exp(-Y)), with Y exactly Gamma(d,1). A uniformly integrable Gamma-density ratio and factorial-moment upper bound give the Poisson-tail integral. Integration by parts yields the Gamma coefficient. Counting window candidates depends only on independent centers and has second factorial moment o(n f_d(log n)); outside-window contribution is o of the same scale by a uniform exponential envelope. Therefore probability and expectation of qualifying vertices have the same leading term. Exact r-star expectation uses minimum of r+1 iid continuous coordinates. Replayed standard-library checker passed 203 finite exact/numerical consistency checks; it is not treated as proof.

value.rationale: Quantifies the rare-side fixed directed-degree event of a natural high-dimensional random order to a sharp relative-error asymptotic beyond its known existence threshold, with a universal Gamma prefactor and explicit dimension normalization. For every fixed r>=2 it identifies a nonempty interval where the expected count of r-stars diverges even though the event of any star vanishes. This expectation-typicality separation exposes rare-hub condensation important for interpreting mean motif counts.
